proposedMathematics.units: Input/mean/standard deviation share compatible data units; variance has squared data units; count dimensionless. Engine has no unit conversion or unit metadata.
proposedMathematics.interpretation: Sample variance is the n−1 estimator; sample standard deviation is its square root, not an asserted unbiased estimator of population SD. No distribution fitting, normality inference or confidence interval is computed.

exactInputOutput.runtimeRestriction: sample singleton passes schema but calculate throws ordinary Error('Sample statistics require at least two values'); population singleton allowed; empty, NaN, infinities/out-of-bound values rejected by schema
exactInputOutput.ui: StatisticsDatasetTool in src/components/calculator-interactive.tsx; default raw '1, 2, 2, 4', population. parseDataset splits whitespace/comma/semicolon, filters empty tokens, Number converts, requires at least one and all finite. Thus repeated separators ignored, malformed nonnumeric text invalid. Engine still enforces cardinality/magnitude.
exactInputOutput.workflow: Same native input/output supplied to CalculatorAccountActions; version 1; null output on parser/calculation failure. sixScenarioMetadata maps Dataset/Dataset type and count/mean/variance/sd; no automatic solver inferred.

algorithmAndPrecision.mean: stableSum uses compensated summation with correction, divided by length; variance recomputes mean with same helper.
algorithmAndPrecision.variance: Two-pass centered deviations, ordinary left-to-right reduce sum of squares divided by N or n−1; SD Math.sqrt.
algorithmAndPrecision.rounding: No roundTo call/import in dispersion engine: raw binary64 values/steps retained. src/calculators/precision.ts is shared facility, not applied mathematical rounding contract here; supports digits 0..12 and default half-away-from-zero with epsilon tie tolerance when used.
algorithmAndPrecision.domainLimit: Schema bounds prevent ordinary magnitude overflow: sum ≤1e104, deviation magnitude ≤~2e100 and squared-deviation sum ≤~4e204, safely below binary64 overflow. This is a magnitude argument, not an accuracy proof. Arbitrarily tiny nonzero inputs are admitted; squared deviations may underflow to zero. Decimal input representation and cancellation for nearly equal large values remain accuracy limitations; no relative/absolute error guarantee established.
algorithmAndPrecision.openChoice: Owner/reviewer must specify admissible precision/error envelope, tiny-value policy, units/labels, rounding stage/ties/display precision and independent oracle tolerances before applicability approval.
